name: &fTown Crier Hollis
title: &e&lHUB GUIDE
intro: Welcome to the Hub, traveller! Everything worth doing starts in this square.
The Bank and Auction House face this square from the north, the Bazaar and Museum from the south. Every one has a door on the square side.
Every island portal stands in the Portal Plaza, out past the west gate.
Lost? The map's Village page points your compass at any shop, and at the Fairy Pond. Walk into a district once and I can send you back there any time. Here, take a look.
repeat: Here's the map. Districts you have walked into can be reached in a blink, and the Village page finds any shop.

name: &fWarden Ysolde
title: &d&lPORTALS
intro: Eleven gates, eleven islands. I keep them lit.
A gate only lets you through once you are strong enough for what lies beyond it.
The icy one in the middle only wakes in late winter. Ask me and I will show you which ones you can use already.

name: &fDozing Miner Aurel
title: &6&lCOAL MINE
intro: Mmh? Oh. Visitor. Don't mind me, just... resting my eyes.
The tunnel behind me goes deep into the mountain. Coal, iron, plenty of stone for a fresh pick.
Grab a pickaxe from the merchant's hut if you haven't got one. The forge next door sharpens anything.
Want real ore? Walk to the back of the chamber: the old gate there opens onto the Gold Mine. Wake me when you're rich.
repeat: Zzz... coal's to the north... zzz...
Mmh? Oh, it's you. Thanks again for the coal.

name: &fWoodcutter Ansel
title: &2&lFORAGING
intro: Smell that? Fresh-cut oak. Best smell in the world.
The whole Forest around this camp is yours to chop. The trees grow back if you give them a minute.
Get your axe from the lumber merchant, and bring your planks to the carpenter.
When the oak gets boring, the Park portal leads to forests of every kind.
repeat: Chop, chop! The Forest won't fell itself.

name: &fOld Wenna
title: &8&lCHAPEL
intro: Every night they climb out of their graves, and every morning I count fewer stones.
The mausoleum stair leads down to the crypts. The ghouls down there hit far harder than the ones up here.
If you are hunting undead for a contract, the crypts are where the fight is.
And if you ever see one that glitters... run. Or don't. It drops gold.
repeat: Mind the graves. Some of them are still occupied.

name: &fFarmhand Prosper
title: &e&lFARM
intro: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, pumpkins, melons, cane, cocoa and cactus. We grow the lot.
Break the crops and they come back on their own; it's not your job to replant here.
Every few days there's a farming contest on the stage. Bring your best haul.
See the slime pad at the end of the middle track? Step on it and it flings you to the Barn, fields ten times this size.
repeat: Fields are ripe. Go on, help yourself.

name: &fCastellan Merrow
title: &9&lOLD KEEP
intro: This keep held the valley long before the town had a name.
Climb the corner towers if you like. The view of the mountain is worth the ladder.
The ruins to the west were our sister fort. Wolves own it now.
repeat: The towers are open. Mind the battlements.

name: &fArchmage Corvin
title: &5&lWIZARD
intro: The arch outside is awake. I spent a year listening to it hum, and now it is open.
Beyond it lies the Rift: a world that runs on its own clock, where time itself is what you spend.
The Warden of the Arch stands beside it. Bring them a Planar Infusion and they will let you through.
Here, let me show you what I know of the other side.
repeat: The Warden is beside the arch, just west of the tower. Mind your clock in there.

name: &fBarker Jolyon
title: &d&lCARNIVAL
intro: Step right up! When the right mayor holds office, the whole troupe comes to town.
The Ringmaster sets up beside me and hands out free tickets every day, and the booths open on the Carnival Grounds.
Ask me any time and I will tell you if the carnival is in town.

name: &fGamesmaster Lulu
title: &d&lGAMES
intro: Fruit digging, a zombie shootout, catch-a-fish... all run by the troupe when the carnival is in town.
The Token Trader stands next to me then: masks and perks for your tokens.

name: &fCaptain Marlowe
title: &3&lSHIP
intro: Ahoy! This old girl can carry you anywhere the fish are biting.
Most folk start in the Bayou: warm water, strange catches, and nobody asking questions.
The real anglers sail on to the Lotus Atoll once they have the skill for it. Frogs the size of dogs, I swear it.
Tell me where you want to go and we cast off right away.

name: &fJessamy
title: &e&lRETIRED DUELIST
intro: Oh! A visitor. Mind the sword rack.
repeat: Keep your guard up, and your blade sharp.

name: &fAndrin
title: &e&lRESIDENT
intro: Come in, come in. Excuse the mess, I can't bend to tidy.
repeat: That basket kept me fed all winter. Bless you.

name: &fDuke Harrow
title: &e&lOLD SOLDIER
intro: At ease, recruit. Wipe your boots.
repeat: Keep your shield up and your purse in the bank, soldier.

name: &fLorcan
title: &e&lCOURIER
intro: Sorry, sorry, I can't get up. The ankle, you see.
repeat: The ankle's mending. Back on my rounds soon!

name: &fCurator Ottoline Vane
title: &6&lCOLLECTOR
intro: Do knock next time. This is a private collection.
repeat: You may admire the collection. From there.

name: &fWilf
title: &e&lPET FAN
intro: Hi! Are you an adventurer? Do you have a pet?
repeat: When I grow up I'm going to have a hundred pets.
